description: This Java source file defines a Fragment class called DropTargetFragment, which handles drag-and-drop operations within an Android application. It manages image views and permissions related to dragging content from other apps, including requesting and releasing drag-and-drop permissions, processing drag events, and restoring UI state.

classes.name: DropTargetFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment that acts as a drop target for drag-and-drop operations, primarily handling image content and permissions.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Initializes the fragment's UI, sets up the ImageView with an drag listener, and restores saved image URI state.

methods.name: onSaveInstanceState
methods.description: Saves the current image URI to restore state after configuration changes.

methods.name: getExtra
methods.description: Extracts additional information from the drag event's ClipDescription extras, specifically the IMAGE_INFO string.
